summary_ja: 国内の量子・HPC連携はROQUOの運用開始により、135 GB200 NVL4 node、540 GPU、Quantum-X800、SQC Interfaceという具体的な実装段階へ進みました。一方、外部利用、QPUを含むend-to-end性能、共同予約、障害回復、SLAは別途確認が必要です。研究段階ではPilot-QuantumとQ-Dreamerがapplication semanticsを用いる動的制御を提案していますが、production運用の証拠とは区別します。Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: Japanese quantum-HPC integration has moved to a concrete deployment stage with ROQUO's 135 GB200 NVL4 nodes, 540 GPUs, Quantum-X800 fabric, and SQC Interface. External access, end-to-end performance including QPUs, co-reservation, failure recovery, and SLAs still require separate verification. Research-stage Pilot-Quantum and Q-Dreamer propose dynamic control using application semantics, but are kept distinct from evidence of production operation. Consensus is incomplete.

items.name_ja: ROQUO：540 Blackwell GPUとSQC Interfaceを持つHPC側中核
items.name_en: ROQUO: an HPC-side hub with 540 Blackwell GPUs and the SQC Interface
items.statement_ja: 理研はROQUOを135台のGB200 NVL4 node、540 Blackwell GPU、270 Grace CPU、Quantum-X800 InfiniBand（最大3.2 Tbps）、32℃温水冷却で構成し、運用開始したと公表しました。全540 GPUのHPLは19.80 PFLOPSです。SQC Interfaceを介して富岳、ibm_kobe、黎明とのdata交換とjob制御を行う構想で、外部利用はtest-user programを予定しています。運用開始は、QPUを含む全経路の一般利用・SLA・application性能が確立したことを意味しません。
items.statement_en: RIKEN announced the start of ROQUO operations with 135 GB200 NVL4 nodes, 540 Blackwell GPUs, 270 Grace CPUs, Quantum-X800 InfiniBand at up to 3.2 Tbps, and 32-degree-Celsius warm-water cooling. HPL across all 540 GPUs reached 19.80 PFLOPS. The SQC Interface is intended to exchange data and control jobs across Fugaku, ibm_kobe, and Reimei, with external access planned through a test-user program. Starting operations does not establish general access, SLAs, or application performance across the complete QPU path.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIで量子連携を整備する場合、QPUだけでなく、GPU classical backend、interface API、SINET経路、認証、共同予約、storage、冷却と利用制度を一体で検収できます。
items.hpci_relevance_en: An HPCI quantum service can accept the QPU, GPU classical backend, interface API, SINET path, identity, co-reservation, storage, cooling, and access program as one integrated service.
adoption_conditions_ja: SQC Interfaceの公開仕様、対応backend、failure semantics、version policyを確認する。
QPU queue、GPU allocation、network、storageを含むend-to-end applicationを実測する。
test-user programの資格、割当、data governance、support、SLAを記録する。
adoption_conditions_en: Verify the SQC Interface specification, supported backends, failure semantics, and version policy.
Measure end-to-end applications including QPU queues, GPU allocation, network, and storage.
Record test-user eligibility, allocations, data governance, support, and SLAs.

items.name_ja: Pilot-Quantum・Q-Dreamer：application semanticsを用いる研究段階の制御
items.name_en: Pilot-Quantum and Q-Dreamer: research-stage control using application semantics
items.statement_ja: 2026年4月のpreprintは、量子・HPC制御をworkflow、workload、task、resourceの4層に分け、late bindingと動的資源割当を行うPilot-Quantum、circuit cuttingの分割判断を支援するQ-Dreamer、実行motifとmini-appを提案しています。PerlmutterとH100/B200 DGXを含む評価で、Q-Dreamerの最適circuit-cutting構成予測は最大82% accuracyと報告されます。これはproduction schedulerの可用性・fairness・安全性を実証する値ではありません。
items.statement_en: An April 2026 preprint separates quantum-HPC control into workflow, workload, task, and resource layers and proposes Pilot-Quantum for late binding and dynamic allocation, Q-Dreamer for circuit-cutting partition decisions, and execution motifs with mini-apps. Evaluation includes Perlmutter and H100/B200 DGX systems, and reports up to 82% accuracy for predicting optimal circuit-cutting configurations. This does not establish production-scheduler availability, fairness, or safety.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 従来schedulerへQPUを固定resourceとして追加するだけでなく、application semantics、calibration変動、queue、circuit分割を扱うmiddleware層が必要になる可能性があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Rather than adding a QPU as a static resource to a conventional scheduler, HPCI may need a middleware layer that handles application semantics, calibration drift, queues, and circuit partitioning.
adoption_conditions_ja: 82% accuracyのtarget、baseline、test set、誤予測costを確認する。
既存batch scheduler、identity、accounting、予約、failure recoveryとの接続を実証する。
mini-appのmotifがHPCI対象applicationをどこまで代表するか評価する。
adoption_conditions_en: Verify the target, baseline, test set, and cost of errors behind the 82% accuracy.
Demonstrate integration with batch scheduling, identity, accounting, reservations, and failure recovery.
Evaluate how well the mini-app motifs represent HPCI target applications.
